welcome.hero_headline:
Turn every employee into an
AI-powered professional.
welcome.hero_subhead:
Not another e-learning course.
A diagnostic engine + personalized path + live AI coaching, built specifically for each role — and ready for your entire team.
welcome.challenge_heading: Your people are already using AI. The question is whether they're using it well.
welcome.challenge_sub: Three data points that make the case.
welcome.stat1_label: want AI training more than job security
welcome.stat1_context: Your people are asking for this. AI skills are the top professional development priority across every function.
welcome.stat2_label: more AI usage than leaders expect
welcome.stat2_context: Shadow AI is rampant. Employees are already using tools leaders haven't approved — without guardrails or training.
welcome.stat3_label: cite lack of training as the #1 adoption blocker
welcome.stat3_context: Training unlocks ROI. Without it, AI tools sit underused or get misused — both outcomes cost you.
welcome.edc_callout: Across the organization, over 100 employees have already submitted AI use case requests. Meeting support, document summarization, and email drafting rank as the top three needs. This platform builds the skills to do them right — securely, consistently, at scale.
welcome.loop_sub: Four stages. One continuous cycle. Completely personalized.
welcome.stage1_body: 6 open-ended questions scored by AI — no right answers, just your real work. Takes ~5 minutes. Reveals your skill level across all 6 domains.
welcome.stage2_body: AI generates a personalized narrative gap map and sequences your training path.
welcome.stage3_body: Role-specific scenarios + live AI coach. You practice; the coach responds to YOUR answers.
welcome.stage4_body: Hexagon skill radar updates after each module. Watch your gaps close over time.
welcome.loop_callout: The path is yours. Module 1 unlocks immediately based on your biggest gap — not a fixed curriculum everyone follows in the same order.
welcome.caption_diagnostic: Six open-ended questions based on your own work. No multiple choice — you describe how you'd actually use AI. Takes ~5 minutes. Scores all 6 domains simultaneously.
welcome.caption_skills: Your hexagon radar shows exactly where you stand. The AI-generated gap map turns raw scores into plain-language priorities you can act on today.
welcome.caption_module: Each module opens with a reading section that explains the core framework — then immediately asks you to apply it to a realistic work scenario.
welcome.caption_coach: The AI coach responds to what you actually wrote — not a scripted flow. It asks follow-up questions, flags weak reasoning, and models better approaches in real time.
welcome.caption_results: After each module, you get a score breakdown by rubric criterion and a personalized coach note. Your hexagon radar updates immediately.
welcome.diff_sub: Four decisions that separate this from generic e-learning.
welcome.diff1_body: Every practice task is built around real work situations for your specific role — RM, Underwriter, Analyst. No generic "write a prompt about dogs" exercises.
welcome.diff2_headline: An AI coach that actually reads your answer.
welcome.diff2_body: The coach sees exactly what you wrote and responds with contextual feedback. It can't be fooled by a vague answer — it will push back.
welcome.diff3_body: The diagnostic scores 6 domains. Module 1 is the domain where you need the most help — not the one that comes first alphabetically.
welcome.diff4_headline: Your data never leaves your workspace.
welcome.diff4_body: Hosted on GCP Cloud Run and served from your organization's environment. No data sent to third-party training platforms. No external user accounts.
welcome.skill_sub: Every domain is scored independently. The diagnostic tells you exactly where you sit on each axis.
welcome.domain3_reframe: Never be caught out by an AI error
welcome.domain4_reframe: Generate insights in minutes, not hours
welcome.domain5_reframe: Know every stakeholder better than anyone
welcome.attribution: Aligned with the Alan Turing Institute's AI Skills Framework for Knowledge Workers (2024).
welcome.mastery_note: Every domain is scored independently. The diagnostic tells you exactly where you sit on each axis.
welcome.roadmap_sub:
This is version 1. Three roles are live today.
The roadmap below reflects what's already being built.
welcome.road1_body: PM, Engineer, Legal, Finance — same methodology, role-specific scenarios built on the same 6-domain skill model.
welcome.road2_body: % workforce at Practitioner+ per domain; exportable for quarterly reporting and board packs.
welcome.road3_body: Admin view: completion rates, average scores by department, skill gap heatmap across the workforce.
welcome.road4_body: A dedicated module covering M365 Copilot — the tool most frequently requested by employees.
